blocks.text: Cebuano guard Reinhard Jumamoy delivered the game-winner for the National University (NU) Bulldogs, drilling a triple off the glass with 0.5 seconds left to stun the University of Santo Tomas (UST) Growling Tigers, 87-85, in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Men’s Basketball Tournament on Saturday, October 10, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum....
